app_fee.value: The Graduate School application fee is $90, required with every application.
app_fee.quote: A nonrefundable $90 application fee is required with your application.

fee_waiver.value: Waivers are granted for financial hardship, participation in a qualifying program, or a recruiting-event code; nationality is not one of the criteria.
fee_waiver.quote: Applicants may be eligible to request a fee waiver based on the following criteria: financial hardship, participation in a program (past or present), or attending a recruiting event

gre_general.value: The Graduate School sets no GRE rule; each department or program sets its own (see the program records).
gre_general.quote: The Graduate School does not have a minimum score requirement; each department or program may set its own.

toefl_min.value: The Graduate School sets no minimum TOEFL score; departments may set their own.
toefl_min.quote: The Graduate School does not have a minimum score requirement.

ielts_min.value: The Graduate School sets no minimum IELTS score; departments may set their own.
ielts_min.quote: The Graduate School does not have a minimum score requirement.

english_waiver.value: An English-medium Indian degree is exempt only if the institution certifies that undergraduate instruction was entirely in English and the degree is awarded before enrollment at Princeton.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants whose undergraduate instruction is entirely in English as certified by the institution and for whom the degree will be awarded prior to anticipated enrollment at Princeton.
